head: A young Chinese carmaker
bought Volvo.
slides.sub: Then it did something unusual: it stepped back.

image.label: A Scandinavian car factory gate in winter light
image.brief: 겨울 오후 스웨덴 해안 도시의 자동차 공장 정문. 회색 하늘, 차가운 푸른 톤. 실제 로고나 브랜드 표식 없음.

head: Ford had a famous brand
it couldn't afford.
body: Ford bought Volvo Cars in 1999, hoping a safe, premium Swedish name would lift its luxury lineup.
A decade later, the financial crisis hit. Ford needed cash and focus at home, and Volvo was losing money. It went up for sale.

image.label: An empty boardroom with a sale document on the table
image.brief: 2009년 무렵 미국 기업 회의실. 텅 빈 의자들과 탁자 위 서류 한 장. 어둡고 무거운 분위기. 실존 인물 없음.

slides.label: what Geely paid in 2010, far below the $6.45 billion Ford had paid
body: The buyer was Zhejiang Geely, a private carmaker run by its founder, Li Shufu. It had made cars for little more than a decade.

image.label: Two price tags, one large and one much smaller
image.brief: 크기가 크게 다른 가격표 두 장이 나란히 놓인 정물. 차가운 조명, 미니멀한 구도.

head: Could a newcomer
run a premium brand?
body: Geely reportedly began making fridge parts before moving into cars in the late 1990s. Its own cars were cheap and little known abroad.
In Sweden, many worried jobs, engineering and the brand itself would drift to China.

image.label: Swedish factory workers watching news on a breakroom TV
image.brief: 2010년 스웨덴 공장 휴게실. 작업복 차림 노동자들의 뒷모습이 TV 뉴스를 지켜봄. 얼굴은 보이지 않게.

head: You own Volvo now.
What do you do?
body: You paid for a respected brand with deep engineering skill. Your own company is younger, cheaper and less experienced.

options.text: Move much of Volvo's production to China to cut costs
options.feedback: Costs would fall fast. But buyers pay for what Volvo means, and that meaning could fall too. Keep swiping.

options.text: Merge Volvo into Geely quickly and share parts across both
options.feedback: Shared parts save money. Rushed, they can blur the brand and push out the engineers you paid for. Keep swiping.

options.text: Keep Volvo Swedish-run, fund it and let it set its own plans
options.feedback: Your money, their decisions. It's a bet that patience pays more than control. Keep swiping.

image.label: A car key on a desk between two roads on a map
image.brief: 지도 위 두 갈래 길 사이에 놓인 자동차 열쇠. 위에서 내려다본 구도. 실제 브랜드 디자인 없음.

head: The owner stayed home.
The money didn't.
body: Volvo kept its headquarters in Gothenburg, its own board and Swedish-led management. A line often quoted from Li Shufu: Geely is Geely, Volvo is Volvo.
Geely funded a long-term plan Volvo's engineers drew up themselves.

image.label: Engineers around a clay car model in a design studio
image.brief: 스칸디나비아풍 디자인 스튜디오에서 점토 자동차 모형을 둘러싼 엔지니어들의 실루엣. 밝은 자연광.

head: A new platform.
A new XC90.
body: Volvo built a new base for its larger cars, called SPA. The first car on it, a new XC90 SUV, was unveiled in 2014 and won wide praise.
More models followed on the same base, cutting the cost of each one.

image.label: A premium SUV on a wet Nordic coastal road
image.brief: 비에 젖은 북유럽 해안 도로를 달리는 고급 SUV. 실제 차 디자인은 따라 하지 않은 일반적 형태.

slides.label: Volvo cars sold in 2019, nearly double 2010, according to the company
body: The brand Ford sold in a crisis was growing in Europe, China and the United States, where Volvo opened its first American factory.

image.label: Rows of new cars waiting at a port
image.brief: 항구에 줄지어 선 신차들을 위에서 내려다본 장면. 새벽빛, 로고 없음.

head: Sharing came later,
on Volvo's terms.
body: Once Volvo was strong, the two worked together. They jointly developed a smaller car platform, CMA, used by Volvo and by Geely's new brand Lynk & Co.
Geely got the know-how it wanted, without breaking what it bought.

image.label: Two teams handing a blueprint across a table
image.brief: 탁자 너머로 설계도를 건네는 두 팀의 손. 동서양 엔지니어 협업 느낌, 얼굴 없음.

head: Buy the strength.
Don't absorb it.
body: Many buyers rush to integrate, chasing savings on paper. The real value often lives in people, culture and brand that rushing destroys.
Geely kept control of the money and let Volvo keep control of the work. Synergies came once both sides could trust them.

image.label: Two separate gears turning together
image.brief: 떨어져 있지만 맞물려 함께 도는 톱니바퀴 두 개. 단순한 그래픽.

head: Before you change it,
know why you bought it.
body: What makes a company, team or supplier valuable can be what heavy control breaks first.
**Try it today:** name one thing someone else does better than you. What would you protect if it were yours?

image.label: A single car's taillights on a quiet road at dusk
image.brief: 해 질 녘 조용한 북유럽 시골길 위 자동차 한 대의 후미등. 차분한 톤.

factChecks.note: Ford의 Volvo Cars 인수가(1999년, 약 64억 5천만 달러)와 Geely의 인수가(18억 달러, 2010년 3월 계약·8월 완료)는 Ford·Geely 발표와 당시 Reuters, BBC 등 보도로 확인하세요. → [2026-11-02 확인] Ford 1999년 약 64억 5천만 달러, Geely 2010년 18억 달러(3월 합의) 확인.
Geely가 1980년대에 냉장고 부품 사업으로 시작했고 1990년대 말 자동차 생산에 들어갔다는 내용은 Zhejiang Geely Holding 공식 연혁 기준입니다. 카드에는 "reportedly"로 표시했습니다.
"Geely is Geely, Volvo is Volvo"는 Li Shufu가 여러 인터뷰에서 했다고 널리 보도된 표현입니다. 카드에는 "a line often quoted"로 출처를 밝혔습니다. 원문 보도로 표현을 확인하세요.
본사(예테보리)·스웨덴 경영진·별도 이사회 유지, SPA 플랫폼 기반 2세대 XC90(2014년 공개)은 Volvo Cars 공식 연혁과 보도로 확인하세요. → [2026-11-02 확인] 2세대 XC90이 첫 SPA 플랫폼 모델 확인.
2019년 판매 70만 대 이상(705,452대)과 2010년 약 37만 대는 Volvo Cars 연간 판매 발표 기준입니다. 카드에는 "nearly double, according to the company"로만 적었습니다. → [2026-11-02 확인] 2019년 705,452대 판매 확인.
CMA 플랫폼의 공동 개발과 Lynk & Co 브랜드 출범(2016년 공개)은 Geely·Volvo 발표 기준입니다. 통합이 전혀 없었다는 것은 신화이므로, 후반에 기술 공유가 있었음을 함께 적었습니다.
2010년 당시 Geely의 경험 부족과 스웨덴 내 우려는 당시 언론 보도의 정성적 서술로만 적었고, 노조 발언 등 구체적 인용은 넣지 않았습니다.
